subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should maintainers require a fresh current-main live Discord reproduction after the supervisor listener fix before choosing a repair boundary for this 1005/1006 no-reconnect issue?
rationale: The latest shipped release is live-proven broken, but current main has a post-release adjacent listener fix and the earlier close-handler mitigation was rejected for lacking a public-path stale-state reproduction.

options.title: Require current-main live proof first
options.body: Capture a current-main Discord 1005/1006 close with redacted logs or transport-harness proof, then fix the owner transition shown by that evidence.

options.title: Sponsor the close-handler mitigation
options.body: Accept a bounded abnormal-close re-arm mitigation with promoted diagnostics, treating it as a recovery chokepoint while future logs identify the hidden transition.

options.title: Implement operator reconnect fallback only
options.body: Add a channel-scoped reconnect control as a damage reducer, while leaving the automatic recovery bug open until a root-cause fix is proven.

recommendation.title: Require current-main live proof first
recommendation.body: Capture a current-main Discord 1005/1006 close with redacted logs or transport-harness proof, then fix the owner transition shown by that evidence.
